metadata.description: Agentic coding toolkit: sub-agent orchestration, prompt synthesis, and browser automation for Claude Code

plugins.name: agentic-coding-tools
plugins.description: Complete agentic coding toolkit with skills for sub-agent orchestration (super-agent, cursor-agent, gemini-agent, codex-agent), prompt synthesis commands (handoff-prompt-to, pair-prompt-to, reflect, walkthrough), multi-agent review (council, multi-agent-review, swarm-think), and specialized agents (browser-qa, ui-clone)

plugins.name: super-agent
plugins.description: SDK-based Claude agent with full Task tool access. Use for executing handoff prompts or spawning nested sub-agents.

plugins.name: cursor-agent
plugins.description: Wrapper around cursor-agent CLI for non-interactive runs (prompt via args/file/stdin) with resume support.

plugins.name: gemini-agent
plugins.description: Wrapper around gemini CLI for non-interactive runs (prompt via args/file/stdin) with resume support.

plugins.name: codex-agent
plugins.description: Wrapper around codex CLI for non-interactive runs (prompt via args/file/stdin) with resume support. Outputs session_id for conversation continuation.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Multi-agent debate orchestrator. Runs parallel agent panels with a Chair synthesizing responses across rounds.

plugins.name: build-prompt-chain
plugins.description: Build a phased prompt chain with orchestration file from a monolithic implementation prompt.

plugins.name: super-implement
plugins.description: Transform a plan into execution-ready prompt artifacts — single handoff prompts, parallel prompts, or phased prompt chains with orchestration.

plugins.name: save-plan
plugins.description: Save the current session's plan file to the project's .ai-reference/plans/ folder for editing and reuse.

plugins.name: spec-mode
plugins.description: Interactive spec-building mode. Incrementally build a feature spec through conversation with decisions tracked in Agreed/Open sections.

plugins.name: chrome-screenshot
plugins.description: Extract browser screenshots from session transcripts

plugins.name: read-transcript
plugins.description: Read Claude Code .jsonl transcript files in a token-efficient format. Use instead of Read for conversation content.
